description: At the north end of former Schokland, the lighthouse keeper's house sits on the Oud-Emmeloord terp above a small harbour basin with wooden piles. It is a low brick house, not a tall light tower. The Middelbuurt church is farther south and is not in this frame. It is mainly clear, about 9.6°C, with wind near 1.4 km/h and cloud cover about 42%.
